prompts.name: El Silbón
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D fighting-game sprite atlas for Arena Criolla.
Create an original polished cel-shaded arcade illustration with clear dark ink contours, readable full-body silhouette, expressive face, restrained painterly texture, natural costume detail. The design is a playful game adaptation of Venezuelan folklore, not a photograph, not a flat icon, not an anime character.
Produce a landscape 2:1 TRANSPARENT ALPHA atlas with EXACTLY EIGHT isolated complete full-body figures: four equal columns by two equal rows. One figure per cell, generous empty gutters and outer margins. All eight figures depict the SAME character, costume, face, proportions and colors. All face screen RIGHT in three-quarter view. Planted feet align to a consistent baseline in each row.
Order top row: 1 idle ready stance with face clearly visible, 2 guarding/blocking, 3 running left leg forward, 4 running right leg forward. Bottom row: 5 airborne tucked jump, 6 extended right-hand strike, 7 high rightward kick with other foot planted, 8 recoiling hurt pose leaning back. Keep all limbs, costume, ears, tails, props and extended kicks fully inside each own cell. Costume and any held props must connect to the body as ONE clean silhouette in every cell.
Actual transparent background. No floor, ground shadows, labels, text, grid, borders, extra characters, floating particles, detached props, gore or cropped extremities. Eight poses only.

Character design: Very tall slender male llanero specter, pale weathered angular face and hollow dark eyes, wide battered straw hat, ragged olive-brown poncho over ivory shirt, long charcoal trousers, battered brown boots. A closed large burlap sack is firmly strapped to his back; small bone-shaped stitched emblems on sack, no exposed gore. Long thin arms and legs, haunting whistling lips, unmistakable rural silhouette. Slightly spooky but charming arcade villain.
